payloadSourceNote: One test string per line, supplied by the project from a maintained open-source security testing list of its choice. If the file is missing, the suite is reported as 'not run: payload list missing' and nothing is sent.
appliesTo: every text input, query parameter, path parameter and JSON body field of the endpoints in scope, sent through the UI and directly to the API
pass: Each string is rejected with a 4xx or stored and shown literally. No 500, no database error text in any response, the record count only changes for the targeted record, and response times stay normal.
fail: A 500, database or driver error text in a response, rows the caller should not see, records changed outside the targeted one, or a response noticeably slower than the same request with plain input.

detect.responseText: no database/driver error messages or stack traces
detect.dbCheck: read-only count of the affected tables before and after; only the targeted record may differ
detect.timing: flag responses more than 3x slower than the plain-input baseline

fix: Use parameterised queries / prepared statements everywhere input reaches the database; never build SQL by string concatenation; return generic error messages.
